title: Sesame Slab
description: A super-sweet, nutty slab made from caramelised sugar, coconut oil and tahini. Sets quickly and cuts into squares. Serve on the side of an espresso.
steps: Line a 25cm x 18cm baking tray with greaseproof paper pressed firmly into the corners.
Heat the sugar in a saucepan over medium heat until it caramelises and turns amber (about 6 minutes, or 118–120°C on a sugar thermometer). Add the coconut oil and mix.
Take off the heat and add the tahini (stir the jar first), stirring constantly. Work quickly as it sets fast.
Scrape into the baking tray, smooth the top with a palette knife. Refrigerate for 30 minutes before cutting into squares.
notes: Makes 18 squares. Per square estimate. Sprinkle with toasted coconut or sesame seeds for added crunch.
